intents.answer: I'm ShopEasy's FAQ assistant, a small chatbot that finds the closest answer in our help articles. Try asking about delivery, returns, refunds or payments.

faqs.question: How long does delivery take?
variants: When will my order arrive?
What is the estimated delivery time?
How many days does shipping take?
When will I get my package?
When does my parcel get here?
How long until my order is delivered?
How soon will I receive my order?
How long will it take to get my order?
How long will my order take?
faqs.keywords: delivery time days arrive dispatch
faqs.answer: Standard delivery takes 3-5 business days in metro cities and 5-7 business days elsewhere in India. Express delivery (1-2 business days) is available at checkout for selected pin codes.

faqs.question: How much does shipping cost?
variants: What are the delivery charges?
Is shipping free?
Do you offer free delivery?
Is there a minimum order for free shipping?
Do I have to pay for delivery?
Do I need to pay for shipping?
Are there any delivery fees?
faqs.keywords: shipping charges fee free delivery cost
faqs.answer: Delivery is free on orders above Rs. 499. For smaller orders, standard delivery costs Rs. 49 and express delivery costs Rs. 99.

faqs.question: How can I track my order?
variants: Where is my order?
How do I check my order status?
Track my package
I want to know the status of my shipment
Where is my package?
Where is my parcel right now?
Can I see where my delivery is?
faqs.keywords: tracking track status shipment parcel
faqs.answer: Open My Orders in your account and select the order to see live tracking. We also email and SMS a tracking link as soon as your order ships.

faqs.question: My order is delayed. What should I do?
variants: Why is my delivery late?
My order has not been delivered yet
My package hasn't arrived
It has been a week and nothing has come
faqs.keywords: delayed late delay not arrived missing
faqs.answer: We are sorry for the wait. Check the live status in My Orders first. If your order is more than 3 days past its estimated date, tap Need Help on that order and we will chase the courier or send a replacement.

faqs.question: Can I change my delivery address?
variants: How do I update the shipping address?
I entered the wrong address
Change the address after placing an order
faqs.keywords: address change update wrong location
faqs.answer: You can change the address from My Orders until the order is packed. After that the address can't be changed, but you can contact support and we will try to redirect the parcel.

faqs.question: How do I cancel my order?
variants: Can I cancel an order after placing it?
I want to cancel my purchase
Cancel my order
faqs.keywords: cancel cancellation order
faqs.answer: Go to My Orders, choose the order and tap Cancel. Orders can be cancelled until they are shipped. If you already paid online, the refund goes back to your original payment method in 5-7 business days.

faqs.question: What is your return policy?
variants: How many days do I have to return an item?
Can I return a product?
Are returns accepted?
Is there a return window?
faqs.keywords: return policy window days eligible
faqs.answer: Most items can be returned within 7 days of delivery if they are unused and in their original packaging with tags. Innerwear, personalised items and gift cards cannot be returned.

faqs.question: How do I return a product?
variants: How do I start a return?
I want to return my order
What are the steps to return an item?
Raise a return request
faqs.keywords: return pickup request send back
faqs.answer: Open My Orders, select the item, tap Return and choose a reason. We will schedule a free pickup within 2 business days. Hand over the item in its original packaging.

faqs.question: When will I get my refund?
variants: How long does a refund take?
Where is my refund?
What is my refund status?
I haven't received my money back
faqs.keywords: refund money back credited status
faqs.answer: Refunds are issued 2-3 business days after the returned item reaches our warehouse and passes a quality check. Your bank may then take 3-5 business days to show it. For cash on delivery orders you can choose a bank transfer or a ShopEasy wallet credit.

faqs.question: Can I exchange an item for a different size or colour?
variants: How do I exchange a product?
It is the wrong size, can I swap it?
What is the exchange policy?
I want a different size
faqs.keywords: exchange swap size colour replace
faqs.answer: Yes. Choose Exchange instead of Return in My Orders within 7 days of delivery and select the new size or colour. Exchanges are free and depend on stock availability.

faqs.question: What if I receive a damaged or wrong item?
variants: My product arrived broken
I got the wrong item
The package was damaged
The item is defective
I received a faulty product
The product I received is broken
My order arrived damaged
The item arrived in bad condition
faqs.keywords: damaged broken wrong defective faulty incorrect
faqs.answer: We are sorry about that. Report it within 48 hours of delivery from My Orders using Report a Problem and attach a photo. We will arrange a free pickup and send a replacement or a full refund.

faqs.question: Which payment methods do you accept?
variants: How can I pay for my order?
Do you accept UPI?
Can I pay with a credit card?
Is net banking available?
Do you take debit cards?
faqs.keywords: payment pay upi credit debit card netbanking wallet gpay phonepe paytm
faqs.answer: We accept UPI, credit and debit cards, net banking, popular wallets, ShopEasy gift cards and cash on delivery.

faqs.question: Is cash on delivery available?
variants: Can I pay when the product arrives?
Do you have COD?
Is there a pay on delivery option?
faqs.keywords: cod cash delivery pay later
faqs.answer: Cash on delivery is available on orders up to Rs. 10,000 for most pin codes, with a fee of Rs. 40. You will see the option at checkout if your pin code is eligible.

faqs.question: My payment failed but money was deducted. What should I do?
variants: Money was debited but my order was not placed
Payment deducted but no confirmation
I was charged twice
The transaction failed but I was charged
The amount was deducted but the order failed
Money was cut from my account but the order failed
faqs.keywords: payment failed deducted debited charged twice transaction
faqs.answer: Don't worry. If the order was not created, the amount is returned automatically to your account within 5-7 business days. If you don't see it after that, write to support@shopeasy.example with the transaction ID.

faqs.question: Do you offer EMI or no-cost EMI?
variants: Can I pay in instalments?
What are the EMI options on a credit card?
Is there a no cost EMI?
Can I pay monthly?
Is EMI available?
faqs.keywords: emi instalment installment monthly no-cost
faqs.answer: EMI is available on orders above Rs. 3,000 with selected credit cards, for 3, 6 or 9 months. No-cost EMI is shown on eligible products at checkout.

faqs.question: How do I use a coupon or promo code?
variants: Where do I enter a discount code?
My coupon is not working
How do I apply a promo code?
How can I get a discount?
faqs.keywords: coupon promo code discount voucher offer
faqs.answer: Enter the code in the Apply Coupon box on the payment page and tap Apply. Codes can't be combined, and each one has its own minimum order value and expiry date. If a code doesn't work, check those two conditions first.

faqs.question: How do gift cards work?
variants: Can I buy a gift card?
How do I redeem a gift card?
How do I check my gift card balance?
faqs.keywords: gift card voucher redeem balance
faqs.answer: Buy a ShopEasy gift card from the Gift Cards page. The receiver gets a code by email and can enter it at checkout. Gift cards are valid for 12 months and any balance stays on the card.

faqs.question: How do I create an account?
variants: How do I sign up?
How can I register on ShopEasy?
Do I need an account to order?
Make a new profile
faqs.keywords: account sign up register create profile guest
faqs.answer: Tap Sign Up, enter your name, email and mobile number, and verify the OTP we send. You can also check out as a guest, but an account lets you track orders and save addresses.

faqs.question: I forgot my password. How do I reset it?
variants: How do I reset my password?
I can't log in to my account
How can I change my password?
I have a login problem
faqs.keywords: password reset forgot login sign in locked
faqs.answer: On the login page tap Forgot Password, enter your registered email or mobile number, and follow the link or OTP we send. Choose a new password with at least 8 characters.

faqs.question: How can I update my email or phone number?
variants: How do I change my mobile number?
How do I edit my profile details?
Update my account information
faqs.keywords: update change edit email phone mobile profile details
faqs.answer: Go to Account > Profile, edit your email or phone number and verify it with a one-time password.

faqs.question: How do I delete my account?
variants: Please remove my data
I want to close my account
How do I deactivate my profile?
Delete my personal information
faqs.keywords: delete remove close deactivate account data privacy
faqs.answer: Go to Account > Privacy > Delete Account, or email support@shopeasy.example from your registered address. Open orders must be completed first, and your data is removed within 30 days.

faqs.question: I didn't receive my order confirmation email
variants: Where is my confirmation email?
I got no order confirmation
Did my order go through?
faqs.keywords: confirmation email placed went through
faqs.answer: Check your spam or promotions folder first. You can also find every order under My Orders in your account. If the order is not listed there, it was not placed and you were not charged.

faqs.question: How can I download my invoice or GST bill?
variants: Where do I get the tax invoice?
I need a GST invoice
How do I download the bill for my order?
I need an invoice for reimbursement
faqs.keywords: invoice gst bill receipt tax
faqs.answer: Open My Orders, select the order and tap Download Invoice. To add your GST number for a business purchase, enter it at checkout before paying.

faqs.question: Do products come with a warranty?
variants: How do I claim a warranty?
Is there a warranty on electronics?
Is there a guarantee on products?
faqs.keywords: warranty guarantee repair service claim electronics
faqs.answer: Electronics and appliances carry the manufacturer's warranty, usually 1 year. The warranty card is in the box and the invoice in My Orders is your proof of purchase. For a claim, contact the brand's service centre, or write to us and we will help.

faqs.question: How can I contact customer support?
variants: What is your support email?
I want to talk to a human
What are your customer care hours?
Is there a helpline number?
Can I speak to an agent?
faqs.keywords: contact support customer care helpline agent email human phone
faqs.answer: You can chat with this assistant any time or email support@shopeasy.example. Our team replies Monday to Saturday, 9 am to 8 pm IST, usually within 24 hours.

faqs.question: Do you ship internationally?
variants: Can I order from outside India?
Do you deliver to other countries?
Do you deliver abroad?
faqs.keywords: international overseas abroad outside country foreign usa uk america canada australia uae europe singapore
faqs.answer: Not yet. We currently deliver only within India. International shipping is planned for later.

faqs.question: What if an item is out of stock?
variants: When will the product be back in stock?
Can you notify me when it is available?
The product is sold out
What is the restock date?
faqs.keywords: stock sold unavailable restock notify available
faqs.answer: Tap Notify Me on the product page and we will email you as soon as it is back. Restock dates are shown on the page when we know them.

faqs.question: Are your products genuine?
variants: Are the products original?
Do you sell fake or duplicate items?
Is it authentic?
Are these branded products real?
faqs.keywords: genuine original authentic fake duplicate branded
faqs.answer: Yes. We buy directly from brands and authorised distributors, and every item is quality-checked before it ships. If you ever doubt a product, report it within 7 days and we will investigate.

faqs.question: How do reward points work?
variants: How do I earn loyalty points?
Where can I use my points?
What is the ShopEasy rewards programme?
faqs.keywords: reward points loyalty earn redeem
faqs.answer: You earn 1 point for every Rs. 100 you spend. Each point is worth Rs. 1 off your next order, and points expire after 12 months. Your balance is under Account > Rewards.

faqs.question: Can I place a bulk or corporate order?
variants: Do you offer business discounts?
I want to buy in large quantities
Do you take wholesale orders?
Corporate gifting
faqs.keywords: bulk corporate wholesale business large quantity
faqs.answer: Yes. For orders of 20 or more items, email business@shopeasy.example with your list and delivery city. We will reply with a quote and a business discount within 2 working days.
